faq.question: What does Nurlana mean?
faq.answer: Nurlana is associated with the Arabic form نُورْلَانَا, whose core sense is nurlana; light (azerbaijani form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Nurlana?
faq.answer: Nurlana is associated with Arabic. Nurlana is an Azerbaijani female given name formed from Arabic نُور (nūr, 'light').

faq.question: Is Nurlana an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form نُورْلَانَا is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Nurlana an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Nurlana can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Nurlana a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Nurlana should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūr occurs in the Quran as a term for light.
